items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And so we worked with, oh, Don Byas (PHONETIC), Ben Webster, Coleman Hawkins used to sit in with us.

ctx.x: Tell me about working with Stuff and John. You worked in Chicago how long before you went to New York?

Just about a year, that's all. We weren't together that long. And then we stayed -- we were in New York -- we stayed together maybe two to three years. And then I started working up and down 52nd Street at that point. We used to play with, Ray Perry, the other violinist that was with Lionel Hampton, very good. And after, then I worked with -- they used to hire John and I as a team, because we were on time. We'd show up to work on time, you know, and we wore our uniforms. We kept our home style together. And so we…
That was what year? Or what years?
